assets.description: Steel-plant bridge crane recording; unreviewed candidate for a terminal crane substitute.
assets.creator: Work With Sounds / Technical Museum of Slovenia; sound recordist Dušan Oblak
assets.attribution: WWS Crane, Work With Sounds / Technical Museum of Slovenia, sound recordist Dušan Oblak, CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); converted from Ogg Vorbis to PCM WAV; source https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:WWS_Crane.ogg
assets.authenticity_evidence: The item page identifies a five-ton bridge crane at a steel plant, not a container crane; suitability for any terminal action is unverified.
assets.playback_guidance: Candidate for playback once at a crane point source after listening review; do not loop without boundary review.
assets.processing: Original WWS_Crane.ogg downloaded from https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:Redirect/file/WWS_Crane.ogg; original SHA-256 0b673f3560432af138236c00c1f1bf7616f77e01af9f7c094d58466bd59e2d67. FFmpeg 7.1 essentials build: ffmpeg -hide_banner -i WWS_Crane.ogg -map 0:a:0 -ac 1 -ar 48000 -c:a pcm_s16le -n crane.wav. Source already mono 48000 Hz; decoded Vorbis to 16-bit PCM, no trimming or normalization. This is one derivative of one source; source_sha256 field records the prepared WAV supplied to import.
assets.quality_notes: Lossy 62 kbps Ogg Vorbis source limits fidelity. Automated PCM checks passed; perceptual quality and suitability remain unknown.
assets.review_notes: No listening was available; original and converted recording need listening and suitability review. Not release-ready. Loop boundaries have not been reviewed.
